article.story: Iowa State (1-0) at No. 21 Iowa (1-0), Sept. 12 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Iowa by 14. Against the spread: Iowa 1-0, Iowa State 0-1. Iowa ranks 21st on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 20%. Iowa State is 14th in the FBS with a +2 turnover margin. Iowa is 118th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 60% of trips. Iowa State's red zone defense ranks 59th at 100%. Iowa State is 128th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 23:08, compared to Iowa's 32nd-ranked average of 33:51. Team leaders Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 129 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 60 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 183 yards on 11 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 84 yards on 7 catches, 1 TD Iowa State Passing: Jaylen Raynor, 184 yards, 2 TDs, 0 INTs, 50 completion percentage Rushing: Aiden Flora, 45 yards on 7 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Dominic Overby, 85 yards on 2 catches, 0 TDs Last game Iowa beat Northern Illinois 40-0 on Sept. 5. Brown led Iowa with 129 yards on 12-of-20 passing (60.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Moulton had 183 rushing yards on 11 carries and two touchdowns. Diaz recorded 84 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Iowa State defeated Southeast Missouri State 38-10 on Sept. 5. Raynor led Iowa State with 184 yards on 8-of-16 passing (50.0%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 32 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Flora had 45 rushing yards on seven carries and one touchdown. Overby had two receptions for 85 yards. Next game Iowa hosts Northern Iowa on Sept. 19. Iowa State hosts Bowling Green on Sept. 19.
